1.Title: Ally Assistance
1.Text: A sudden storm struck, but {0} came to your aid. Wayfinder Compasses obtained.

2.Title: Mysterious Shadow
2.Text: A massive shadow appears beneath the waves...
2.QteChoiceText2: A sailor can never let their guard down.
2.QteChoiceText3: Take a chance. It might be a treasure!
2.QteResultText1_1: Fish gathered beneath the shadow, and the crew hauled in a fine catch.
2.QteResultText1_2: The shadow faded away, leaving the voyage unaffected.
2.QteResultText1_3: It turned out to be an uncharted reef, and your ship struck it and was damaged.
2.QteResultText2_1: You steered clear and caught a favorable current.
2.QteResultText2_2: You steered clear. The sea ahead is calm.
2.QteResultText2_3: The detour took you off course and delayed the voyage.
2.QteResultText3_2: You hauled up a drifting crate of supplies.
2.QteResultText3_3: The water churned around the shadow, and the salvage line snapped.

3.Title: Pirates on a Rampage
3.Text: Your ship was captured by pirates, and there were too many of them to fight off...
3.QteChoiceText1: As long as you're still alive, there's still hope. You hand over your valuables.
3.QteChoiceText2: Your silver tongue finally comes in handy.
3.QteChoiceText3: Reason with pirates? No way. Let's fight!
3.QteResultText1_1: The pirate crew suddenly turned on each other. You took advantage of the chaos and saved your supplies.
3.QteResultText1_2: The pirates accepted your valuables and let you go.
3.QteResultText1_3: The pirates are pleased that you knew when to cooperate, but they also took some of your equipment.
3.QteResultText2_1: You convinced the pirates to hand over a nautical chart.
3.QteResultText2_2: Fed up with your endless rambling, the pirates grabbed an empty chest and fled.
3.QteResultText2_3: The negotiations enraged the pirates, and some of your crew were injured.
3.QteResultText3_1: The pirates turned out to be surprisingly weak, so you claimed the treasure.
3.QteResultText3_2: You drove off the pirates, but lost some supplies in the clash.
3.QteResultText3_3: The pirates overpowered you with heavy fire, damaging your ship.

4.Title: Song in the Mist
4.Text: A song echoes through the mist, drawing the crew's attention toward the deep.
4.QteChoiceText1: You follow the beautiful song into the mist.
4.QteChoiceText2: You sense danger in the mist and turn back.
4.QteChoiceText3: The crew answers the song with one of their own.
4.QteResultText1_1: The siren gifted you a pearl.
4.QteResultText1_2: The siren gave you a distant glance, then disappeared.
4.QteResultText1_3: You struck a reef and damaged your ship.
4.QteResultText2_1: You dodged the trap and discovered a safe route.
4.QteResultText2_2: You sailed safely out of the mist.
4.QteResultText2_3: You made a hasty turn and lost some supplies.
4.QteResultText3_1: The siren guided you toward bountiful waters.
4.QteResultText3_2: The siren listened in silence before fading into the mist.
4.QteResultText3_3: You angered the siren, and it summoned a wave that soaked your supplies.
